Let's not forget about that'): docs/assembly-and-the-build-cache.md, 'Devbin's Build Cache for Optimised Release Assembly', a detailed design and tech note plus how-to, written from the as-built after WP01 to WP17 and WP10 to WP14 have landed and WP15 has measured. Objective on the WP; intent/wip.md v3.53 carries it. Its pass over the design also amends s13's registry line ('hv's fleet sets it ... through Molt'), superseded by hv's XDG word (decision 123). It also amends s13's naming of WP08's formula as a cache caller (decisions 110 (4) and 126). The formula reads the release's sums and pushes to the tap, calling no cache verb, so the macOS stage alone writes the RELEASE seal's cache line (vc's ruling on cc's WP08 Q2, 2026-11-01 16:55Z).
